description: This is a PHP class defining a console command 'LDAPSyncUserCommand' for synchronizing users from LDAP within the OrangeHRM system. It includes logic to check LDAP settings, perform the sync, handle errors, and record sync status timestamps.

classes.name: LDAPSyncUserCommand
classes.description: A console command class responsible for synchronizing LDAP users and handling LDAP sync status updates, including error handling.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command used in CLI as 'orangehrm:ldap-sync-user'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the command description for the CLI help output.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the LDAP synchronization process, managing success and failure scenarios, and recording sync timestamps.
